integrity: Analytic argument includes exact coefficient identity, a uniform normalized O_k(m^-2) expansion, exact root-of-unity values and Rouché root-splitting; accompanying finite tests are supplementary, not infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed k >= 2 with n tending to infinity through coprime parameters; the result applies to diagonal numerator zeros, not the complete two-variable kernel zero variety. The leading rate is residue dependent. No independent audit or exhaustive publication-priority verification was performed.
title: Arithmetic boundary layers for zeros of rational Hartogs Bergman numerators
